Aaron "AZR" Ward (born October 2, 1992) is an Australian professional Counter-Strike 2 coach and former player and former Counter-Strike: Global Offensive player of Filipino descent. He started his professional career with Vox Eminor before the team was picked up in 2015 by Renegades, and later in late 2020, by 100 Thieves. AZR currently resides in Denmark.
